commonmark.extraction: Keep every JSON example and its fields unchanged; add spec=commonmark.

gfm.extraction: In document order, read every div.example id, the text of code.language-markdown and code.language-html, and the nearest preceding section heading. Decode HTML text and flatten span.space; replace each displayed U+2192 tab indicator with U+0009 in both payloads, as specified by the page. Preserve all other whitespace, including trailing newlines; add spec=gfm.

serialization: CommonMark examples followed by GFM examples; UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, indent=2, one final newline.
